contract_plain_english: For one-dimensional acoustics, let p(x,t) be the pressure perturbation and u(x,t) the particle velocity, with constant bulk modulus K and density ρ. The equations p_t + K u_x = 0 and u_t + (1/ρ)p_x = 0 are represented by q_t + A q_x = 0 when q is the column (p,u)^T and A has rows (0,K) and (1/ρ,0) [raw PDF page 24, equations (1.5)–(1.6) and intervening paragraph]. The inherited framework uses real variables and a constant real coefficient matrix, with subscripts denoting partial derivatives [raw PDF page 23, equation (1.1) and following paragraph]. The passage does not specify a regularity class or explicit parameter-sign assumptions; nonzero density is an inferred requirement of its ordinary reciprocal [raw PDF page 24, equations (1.5)–(1.6)].
